## Investigation Results

**Status**: Not a bug on master — `detect-flaky-ci` false positive (same root cause as #11799)

### Root Cause

This is the companion test to #11799, from the identical CI run and commit, and shares the exact same root cause. Summary (see #11799 for the original write-up):

- The cited commit `00d87f7cfa520e93f5e407b5996ea837a4db4d0c` is not reachable from this repository's history (not an ancestor of any branch, and not a valid object). It was an ephemeral **merge-queue commit** produced while merging `master` into the `spec/i18n-key-audit` feature branch (PR #11750).
- On that branch, `AdminUpdateButtonRow.tsx` had already been changed to `t('commons:Update')` (namespacing 36 admin call sites), while `FileUploadSetting.spec.tsx`'s update-button assertions — added independently on `master` in the interim — still expected the literal key `'Update'`. The merge-queue run briefly combined the two inconsistent states and failed.
- This was fixed **on the same branch about an hour later**, in commit [`a9b82e5d36`](https://github.com/growilabs/growi/commit/a9b82e5d364f85a2ae47e222b6088a29825fa21b) ("fix(i18n-key-audit): align FileUploadSetting spec with commons:Update key"), which updates both spec assertions to expect `'commons:Update'`.
- PR #11750 has since merged into `master` (merge commit `9a739af3`), and that merge already includes `a9b82e5d36`. Verified on current `master`:
  - `AdminUpdateButtonRow.tsx` calls `t('commons:Update')`.
  - Both assertions in `FileUploadSetting.spec.tsx` expect `'commons:Update'`.
  - These are mutually consistent — no drift between component and spec on current `master`.

(Note: at the time #11799 was investigated, PR #11750 had not yet merged, so master's copies of these two files still read `t('Update')` / `'Update'` — consistent then, for a different reason. Either way, `master` was never actually broken.)

### Evidence

- `git log` / `git merge-base --is-ancestor` confirm `a9b82e5d36` is an ancestor of current `master` HEAD (`9a739af3`), and that `00d87f7c...` does not exist as an object in this repository.
- `a9b82e5d36`'s own commit message independently corroborates this exact sequence of events (namespaced key on the feature branch vs. a freshly-merged spec on master going stale for the merge-queue run).

### Fix Plan

No product code change needed — `master` is already self-consistent and there is nothing to fix there.

As already flagged on #11799: the underlying process gap is in `detect-flaky-ci` itself, which recorded a failure from a commit that was never part of `master`'s history as a "flaky on master" observation. A follow-up worth considering: have the detector skip/exclude observations whose head commit isn't an ancestor of `master` (or otherwise exclude merge-queue/PR-branch runs), so this class of false positive isn't generated again.

No fix implemented here, consistent with the decision already deferred on #11799 — leaving `1️⃣ phase/under-investigation` pending a human decision on whether to close #11799/#11800 as not-a-bug, or route the detector gap into its own tracked improvement.
